新增竖向播放器布局与共享缩放 / Add vertical player layouts and shared scaling

中文：

- 为任务栏子窗口和悬浮窗口新增自动、横向、竖向布局，并在两种模式中共享 70%-125% 显示比例；保存新设置并兼容旧版注册表键。

- 新增 40x40 未旋转封面的竖向界面，以 Unicode 文本单元直立排列左侧歌曲名与右侧歌手名，支持独立纵向滚动，并在媒体信息与播放控制之间自动折叠。

- 完善竖向任务栏的定位、拖动、锁定、缩放约束和弹窗方向，同时让悬浮窗口根据桌面工作区安全恢复位置。

- 同步桌面边缘折叠到横向和竖向布局；竖向布局在屏幕角落优先左右边缘，并保持提示线、动画及动态模块尺寸一致。

- 更新中英文 README，修正并验证 Bilibili 介绍视频链接，同步安装、使用、排错与后续计划说明。

English:

- Add automatic, horizontal, and vertical layouts to taskbar and floating modes with shared 70%-125% scaling, persisted settings, and compatibility with provisional registry keys.

- Add a vertical interface with unrotated 40x40 artwork, upright Unicode text elements for title and artist columns, independent vertical marquees, and auto-collapse between metadata and transport controls.

- Improve vertical taskbar placement, dragging, locking, scale constraints, popup direction, and safe floating-window restoration within the desktop work area.

- Extend desktop-edge collapse to both layouts, prefer left/right edges for vertical layouts at corners, and keep indicators, animations, and dynamic module sizing consistent.

- Update both READMEs, correct and verify the Bilibili introduction link, and synchronize installation, usage, troubleshooting, and roadmap documentation.

重构设置菜单并增加独立主题 / Refactor settings and add independent themes

中文：

- 精简播放器与托盘右键菜单，保留媒体状态、应用跳转、来源选择、详细设置、会话重连、开机启动和退出。

- 新增独立详细设置窗口，按常规、播放器组件、布局与位置、外观、交互与动画、性能与高级分类，并支持即时保存、依赖状态、位置重置和 70%-125% 连续缩放。

- 引入 ApplicationSettings 与 SettingsCoordinator，统一协调现有注册表设置并向运行中的播放器同步变更。

- 将搜索结果移至右侧内容区，保持左侧分类导航稳定，并支持选择结果后跳转到对应设置页。

- 新增菜单与设置窗口的自动、浅色、深色独立主题，同时保留媒体控制窗口文字配色，覆盖右键菜单、详细设置及音量和设备弹窗。

- 修复设置窗口图标资源路径和初始化事件时序导致的闪退，并为窗口创建失败增加错误提示兜底。

- 同步更新中英文 README 中的设置入口、操作说明和主题支持状态。

English:

- Simplify the player and tray context menus while retaining media status, app activation, source selection, detailed settings, session reconnect, startup, and exit actions.

- Add a standalone settings window grouped into General, Player Components, Layout and Position, Appearance, Interaction and Animation, and Performance and Advanced, with immediate persistence, dependency states, position reset, and continuous 70%-125% scaling.

- Introduce ApplicationSettings and SettingsCoordinator to coordinate registry-backed settings and synchronize changes with the running player.

- Move search results into the right content pane, keep category navigation stable, and route selected results to their corresponding settings pages.

- Add independent automatic, light, and dark themes for menus and settings while preserving separate media-control foreground colors across context menus, detailed settings, volume popups, and device popups.

- Fix settings icon resource resolution and initialization event ordering crashes, with a guarded error dialog when window creation fails.

- Update the Chinese and English READMEs for the new settings flow, usage details, and theme support.

新增自动更新检查与版本清单 / Add automatic update checks and release manifest

中文：
- 启动后延迟执行自动检查，并以 24 小时为间隔记录检查尝试，网络失败或程序退出时保持静默。
- 依次使用 GitHub Pages、jsDelivr 与 GitHub Raw 获取公开清单，仅接受 HTTPS 发布链接并过滤有效 SHA-256。
- 在详细设置中增加自动检查开关、手动检查、版本与更新日志展示，以及 GitHub、夸克、百度和蓝奏云下载入口。
- 支持忽略普通版本、强制更新覆盖忽略记录，并在恢复默认设置时清除忽略偏好。
- 更新流程只打开下载页面，不静默下载、执行或替换正在运行的程序。
- 新增 latest.json 版本清单，补充中文在前的双语代码注释，并同步中英文 README 的功能、使用、更新、隐私和 TODO 文档。

English:
- Run a delayed startup check and persist each automatic attempt on a 24-hour interval while keeping network and shutdown failures silent.
- Fall back across GitHub Pages, jsDelivr, and GitHub Raw manifests, accepting only HTTPS release links and valid SHA-256 values.
- Add automatic and manual update controls, version and changelog details, plus GitHub, Quark, Baidu, and Lanzou download channels to detailed settings.
- Support skipping normal releases, let mandatory releases override skipped versions, and clear the skip preference when defaults are restored.
- Open download pages only without silently downloading, executing, or replacing the running application.
- Add the latest.json release manifest, Chinese-first bilingual code comments, and synchronized feature, usage, update, privacy, and TODO documentation in both READMEs.

修复浏览器封面刷新与断线期媒体切换 / Fix browser artwork refresh and grace-period switching

中文：
- 立即读取首次 GSMTC 媒体属性快照中的 Thumbnail，避免丢失仅在该次 WinRT 快照中有效的浏览器封面引用。
- 媒体属性变化时重新核对 Thumbnail，同时保留当前封面，避免刷新期间闪烁或退回占位图。
- 在原有短时退避窗口内持续比较封面指纹，不再把首个临时缩略图误判为最终封面并提前结束。
- 当已选视频来源在断线宽限期内离开列表时，允许滚轮选择唯一剩余的音乐来源并立即取消加载等待。
- 将宽限期到期刷新纳入 WinRT 异常隔离，避免后台刷新失败后永久停留在“正在加载媒体”界面。
- 保持原有约 3.6 秒的有界重试，不引入长期轮询或浏览器图标硬编码过滤。

English:
- Consume Thumbnail from the first GSMTC media-properties snapshot immediately so browser artwork references scoped to that WinRT snapshot are not lost.
- Recheck Thumbnail on media-property changes while retaining the current artwork to avoid flicker or placeholder regressions during refresh.
- Observe artwork fingerprints throughout the existing short backoff window instead of treating the first provisional thumbnail as final and returning early.
- When the selected video source leaves during the reconnect grace period, allow the mouse wheel to select the only remaining music source and cancel loading immediately.
- Route grace-period expiry refreshes through WinRT exception isolation so failures cannot leave the UI permanently stuck on “loading media”.
- Preserve the original bounded retry window of about 3.6 seconds without long-running polling or hard-coded browser-icon filtering.

修复托盘媒体唤醒与边缘尺寸重锚 / Fix tray media activation and edge resize anchoring

中文：
- 枚举媒体进程所属的隐藏顶层窗口，恢复并激活隐藏到系统托盘的播放器。
- 在 MainWindowHandle 为 0 且窗口已销毁时，使用运行中进程的实际可执行文件唤醒单实例应用。
- 保留普通可见窗口的原有激活路径，并补充非默认网易云音乐安装路径和正确工作目录支持。
- 悬浮窗口组件改变尺寸后，依据新宽高重新计算桌面右侧与底部边缘锚点，同时统一处理左侧和顶部边缘。
- 尺寸变化期间终止失效的折叠动画，恢复一致的展开或折叠状态，并同步保存新的正常窗口坐标。

English:
- Enumerate hidden top-level windows owned by media processes, then restore and activate players hidden in the system tray.
- When MainWindowHandle is zero and the app window has been destroyed, launch the running process's actual executable to trigger single-instance activation.
- Preserve the existing activation path for normal visible windows while supporting non-default NetEase Cloud Music locations and the correct working directory.
- Recalculate right and bottom desktop-edge anchors from the new floating-window dimensions after component visibility changes, with consistent handling for left and top edges.
- Stop stale collapse animations during resize, resolve to a coherent expanded or collapsed state, and persist the updated normal window coordinates.

安全加固系统恢复与任务栏宿主 / Harden system recovery and taskbar hosting security

- 增加任务栏宿主窗口句柄校验，确认目标窗口属于 explorer.exe、类名为 Shell_TrayWnd 且客户区有效。
- 对 SetParent、窗口样式、窗口位置、窗口区域和帧刷新等原生调用增加结果检查。
- 任务栏模式切换失败时恢复原父窗口、样式、窗口区域和内部状态，降低 Explorer 重启及句柄竞态造成的窗口异常。
- 增加电源、会话、显示器、DPI 和设备变化处理，系统睡眠、锁屏或环境变化期间暂停定位、动画、频谱和相关定时器。
- 系统恢复时等待唤醒及解锁状态，并通过有限次数重试避免恢复过程卡死。
- 增加 WPF Dispatcher、AppDomain、Task、WinEvent 和全局鼠标钩子的异常隔离及统一诊断日志。
- 日志写入 %LOCALAPPDATA%\AFMediaBar\logs\afmediabar.log，支持大小限制、轮转和旧日志清理。
- 音频设备初始化和采样失败改为退避重试，并在系统环境变化时释放和重置 WASAPI/COM 资源。
- 启动项仅接受当前真实存在的可执行文件路径，发现无效注册表 Run 值时自动清理并记录日志。
- 增加 WTS 会话通知注册与注销声明，并保留 System32 DLL 搜索路径限制。

- Added taskbar host HWND validation for explorer.exe, Shell_TrayWnd, and a valid client area.
- Added result checks for SetParent, window style, position, region, and frame refresh operations.
- Restored the original parent, styles, region, and internal state when taskbar mode switching fails.
- Added power, session, display, DPI, and device-change handling.
- Paused positioning, animation, spectrum rendering, and related timers during suspend, lock, and environment transitions.
- Added bounded recovery retries that wait for the system to wake and the session to unlock.
- Added exception isolation and unified diagnostics logging for WPF Dispatcher, AppDomain, Task, WinEvent, and global mouse-hook callbacks.
- Added log size limits, rotation, cleanup, and safe failure handling.
- Added exponential backoff for audio-device initialization and sampling failures.
- Reset WASAPI/COM resources when the system audio environment changes.
- Validated startup entries against the current executable path and removed invalid Run values.
- Added WTS session notification declarations while retaining the System32 DLL search-path restriction.

新增中西文字体预设与热切换 / Add Latin and CJK font presets with live switching

- 设置新增西文与中文字体双维度预设，覆盖系统自带字体；默认西文 Segoe UI 搭配中文微软雅黑，切换后即时生效、无需重启。
- 字体回退链西文置于中文之前，实现同段中西文混排；日文与韩文自动回退到系统自带字体，无需额外安装。

- Add independent Latin and CJK font presets backed by built-in Windows fonts, defaulting to Segoe UI with Microsoft YaHei; changes apply live without restart.
- Keep Latin before CJK in fallback chains for mixed-script rendering, and let Japanese/Korean glyphs fall back to built-in system fonts.

界面多语言架构：简体/繁体/英文热切换

- 新增 Resources/Languages/{zh-CN,zh-TW,en-US}.xaml 词典（各 200 键），XAML 静态文本迁移为 DynamicResource，切换语言即时生效无需重启

- 字体回退链追加 Microsoft JhengHei，覆盖简体字体缺失的繁体码位

Add UI localization with zh-CN/zh-TW/en-US live switching

- Language dictionaries under Resources/Languages with 200 keys each; XAML text now binds via DynamicResource and switches instantly
- Code-side strings resolved through Localization.Get; settings search decoupled to stable SectionTags
- New language section in General settings (follow system / Simplified / Traditional / English), persisted after first explicit choice

修复悬浮窗口消失与焦点干扰

- 悬浮模式解除隐藏 WPF 所有者窗口，避免窗口被 Windows 自动隐藏
- 修复语言切换、无媒体状态和全屏检测导致悬浮窗口重新折叠的问题
- 移除悬浮模式下的前台窗口抢占，解决托盘菜单和设置窗口周期性失去焦点
- 增加窗口定位、区域刷新和宿主切换失败时的可见性兜底，避免重复恢复循环

Fix floating window disappearance and focus interference

- Detach the hidden WPF owner in floating mode to prevent Windows from hiding the media bar
- Prevent language refresh, media state, and fullscreen checks from collapsing the floating window
- Avoid foreground-window activation in floating mode so tray menus and settings retain focus
- Add visible fallbacks for positioning, region refresh, and host transition failures

优化设置窗口与诊断日志 / Improve settings window and diagnostic logging

- 设置窗口默认使用 820×560 最小尺寸，左侧导航按当前语言最长文字自动调整；关于区域新增多语言打开日志文件入口。
- 日志文件按需创建并保持 1 MiB 轮换，补充设置、更新、媒体会话、设备、音量与窗口操作失败记录；预期取消和兼容回退继续静默。

- Use the 820×560 minimum as the default settings window size and auto-size navigation for the longest localized label; add a localized Open log file action to About.
- Create logs on demand with 1 MiB rotation, and cover settings, updates, media sessions, devices, volume, and window-operation failures while keeping expected cancellation and compatibility fallbacks quiet.

新增媒体内容显示与封面圆角选项 / Add media visibility and artwork corner options

- 播放器组件新增封面、圆角封面与媒体信息独立开关，提供简体、繁体和英文文本并持久化设置。
- 横向与竖向布局会回收隐藏内容占用空间，封面使用真实圆角裁剪；媒体信息关闭后播放控制保持可用。

- Add independent artwork, rounded-artwork, and media-information toggles with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English text plus persistent settings.
- Reclaim hidden content space in horizontal and vertical layouts, clip artwork to real rounded corners, and keep transport controls available when media information is hidden.

媒体暂停时自动切换播放来源 / Auto-switch media source when playback pauses

- 监听全部系统媒体会话的播放状态；当前来源暂停后自动切换到后台正在播放的来源，并优先选择刚触发播放事件的来源。
- 会话列表刷新时同步纠正暂停来源，切换过程经门锁串行化并写入诊断日志，避免并发事件重复抢占。

- Observe playback state across all system media sessions and switch away from a paused current source, preferring the background source that just raised a playing event.
- Apply the same correction during session-list refresh, serialize transitions through the session gate, and log automatic switches without duplicate takeover from concurrent events.

新增独立尺寸、字体粗细与任务栏垂直偏移 / Add independent sizing, font weight, and taskbar offset

- 将统一显示比例拆分为沿任务栏方向的长度与垂直方向的宽度，横竖布局自动映射双轴并兼容迁移旧比例。
- 新增轻、标准、粗三档媒体字体粗细，保持标题与歌手文字层级并即时更新横向和竖向界面。
- 横向依附任务栏模式新增 -20 至 20 的垂直偏移，支持设置滑块与鼠标拖动并持久化。

- Split uniform display scaling into length along the taskbar and width across it, map both axes for horizontal and vertical layouts, and migrate the legacy scale.
- Add light, standard, and bold media font-weight presets while preserving the title/artist hierarchy and updating both layouts live.
- Add a persistent -20 to 20 vertical offset for horizontal taskbar docking, adjustable from settings or by mouse dragging.

新增资源监控任务管理器快捷操作 / Add Task Manager shortcut to resource metrics

- 资源监控新增可选点击操作，横向与竖向布局均可直接打开 Windows 任务管理器，并根据启用状态更新鼠标指针。
- 设置提供简体、繁体和英文文本并持久化；启动失败会显示提示并写入诊断日志。

- Add an optional click action to resource metrics in both horizontal and vertical layouts, opening Windows Task Manager with an enabled-state cursor.
- Persist the localized setting in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English, with user feedback and diagnostics when launch fails.

重做长度间距与厚度缩放 / Redesign length-spacing and thickness scaling

- 厚度调节改为整套播放器等比缩放，封面、按钮、图标与圆角保持协调比例。
- 长度调节统一作用于封面、媒体信息、输出设备、音量、性能指标、分隔线以及播放按钮之间的间距，横向与纵向布局保持一致。
- 放大长度间距曲线，70% 至 125% 的每个档位均产生可见变化，并同步更新三语设置文案。

- Use uniform scaling for the entire player thickness so artwork, buttons, icons, and corner radii keep consistent proportions.
- Apply length spacing consistently across artwork, media information, output device, volume, metrics, divider, and playback controls in both orientations.
- Increase the spacing response so every step from 70% to 125% produces a visible change, with updated Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English labels.

固定设置滑块并支持自定义字体粗细 / Fix slider sizing and add custom font weight

- 设置页长度、厚度、任务栏偏移和字体粗细滑块固定宽度，数值显示紧邻滑动条，不再随菜单宽度移动。
- 字体粗细改为 300–900 连续滑块，显示数值与本地化粗细名称，并即时预览、热切换和持久化。
- 兼容旧版三档字体粗细预设，读取时自动迁移到数值配置。

- Give the layout, thickness, taskbar offset, and font-weight sliders a fixed width, keeping their value labels beside the tracks instead of following the menu width.
- Replace the three-level font-weight preset with a continuous 300–900 slider, localized weight names, live preview, hot switching, and persistence.
- Keep backward compatibility by migrating the legacy three-level font-weight preset on load.

优化诊断日志并移除旧注册表兼容 / Improve diagnostics logging and remove legacy registry compatibility

日志改为本地时间、事件、详情和多行异常堆栈的分段格式，保留 1 MiB 轮转并限制单条异常长度。

移除对 AFShell/MediaBar 与 TaskbarPlayer 旧注册表路径的布局和性能设置读取。

Format diagnostics as readable entries with local timestamps, event names, details, and multiline exception traces while preserving 1 MiB rotation and bounding exception length.

Remove layout and metric setting reads from the legacy AFShell/MediaBar and TaskbarPlayer registry paths.

新增封面圆角弧度调节并自动切换布局 / Add artwork corner radius control and automatic layout switching

- 将封面圆角开关替换为 0–20 弧度滑块，0 为无圆角，并支持三语界面与旧设置迁移。

- 从悬浮模式切换到依附任务栏时自动切换为自动布局。

- Replace the artwork corner toggle with a 0–20 radius slider, where 0 means square corners, with localized UI and legacy-setting migration.

- Automatically switch to automatic layout when changing from floating mode to taskbar mode.

新增布局组件编辑器与四套独立布局档案 / Add component layout editor and four independent layout profiles

- 新增版本化布局模型、JSON 持久化、迁移、标准化、备份和损坏文件恢复。
- 增加组件树编辑、容器能力约束、数值属性面板、实时预览和主窗口动态尺寸。
- 接入媒体、指标、频谱、音量和输出设备组件，补齐三语言资源、搜索索引、CHANGELOG 与人工测试文档。

- Add versioned layout models, JSON persistence, migration, normalization, backups, and invalid-file recovery.
- Add component-tree editing, container capability rules, numeric property panels, live preview, and dynamic host sizing.
- Integrate media, metrics, spectrum, volume, and output-device widgets with localization, search indexing, changelogs, and manual tests.

实现可视化多容器布局与边缘折叠 / Implement visual multi-container layout and edge collapse

- 新增 schema 2 布局模型，将长条内常驻/悬停容器与长条外边缘折叠容器分离，并迁移旧 Root/CollapsedSlot 数据。
